368:   @Override
369:   public Function<ResultRow, ResultRow> makePostComputeManipulatorFn(
370:       final GroupByQuery query,
371:       final MetricManipulationFn fn
372:   )
373:   {
374:     final BitSet optimizedDims = extractionsToRewrite(query);
375:     final Function<ResultRow, ResultRow> preCompute = makePreComputeManipulatorFn(query, fn);
376: 
377:     if (optimizedDims.isEmpty()) {
378:       return preCompute;
379:     }
380: 
381:     // If we have optimizations that can be done at this level, we apply them here
382: 
383:     final List<DimensionSpec> dimensions = query.getDimensions();
384:     final List<ExtractionFn> extractionFns = new ArrayList<>(dimensions.size());
385:     for (int i = 0; i < dimensions.size(); i++) {
386:       final DimensionSpec dimensionSpec = dimensions.get(i);
387:       final ExtractionFn extractionFnToAdd;
388: 
389:       if (optimizedDims.get(i)) {
390:         extractionFnToAdd = dimensionSpec.getExtractionFn();
391:       } else {
392:         extractionFnToAdd = null;
393:       }
394: 
395:       extractionFns.add(extractionFnToAdd);
396:     }
397: 
398:     final int dimensionStart = query.getResultRowDimensionStart();
399:     return row -> {
400:       // preCompute.apply(row) will either return the original row, or create a copy.
401:       ResultRow newRow = preCompute.apply(row);
402: 
403:       //noinspection ObjectEquality (if preCompute made a copy, no need to make another copy)
404:       if (newRow == row) {
405:         newRow = row.copy();
406:       }
407: 
408:       for (int i = optimizedDims.nextSetBit(0); i >= 0; i = optimizedDims.nextSetBit(i + 1)) {
409:         newRow.set(
410:             dimensionStart + i,
411:             extractionFns.get(i).apply(newRow.get(dimensionStart + i))
412:         );
413:       }
414: 
415:       return newRow;
416:     };
